observations: Two Dispatch processes on one database (peer on A, text edits through B, a reply through A after each): head, base and a build that tags cold margin writes all behave the same; A's evictor closes the room B left behind before the reply, so the cold-margin-into-open-stale-room race is not reachable on demand on the real server. The in-process test TestAMarginWriteFromAColdForkIsRenderedByTheRoomItIsPublishedInto covers it and fails on that broken build.

The observer saves little in the CLI-only replay (updateChangesMarkdown share unchanged within noise), as the implementer reported: rooms are mostly cold there. With a browser in the room the skip fires for every margin write (9 of 9 in the probe).
